questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] How do geologists determine the composition of the Earth’s interior layers such as the core and mantle?
A. By analyzing cosmic rays that pass the Earth
B. By analyzing seismic waves
C. By analyzing surface rocks
Answer: B. Seismic waves travel at different speeds and paths through various materials, allowing geologists to infer the properties of the Earth’s core, mantle, and crust.
questions.de: Welche Art von Wellen, deren Geschwindigkeit und Weg sich in verschiedenen Materialien ändern, werten Geologen aus, um den Aufbau von Erdkern und Erdmantel zu erschließen?
questions.en: What kind of waves, whose speeds and paths change as they pass through different materials, do geologists analyse to work out the structure of the Earth’s core and mantle?

timeline.labelEn: Inge Lehmann discovers the Earth’s solid inner core from seismic waves
timeline.labelDe: Inge Lehmann entdeckt anhand seismischer Wellen den festen inneren Erdkern

questions.notes: Wikipedia: the layering of Earth has been inferred indirectly from the travel times of refracted and reflected seismic waves; it also lists volcanic samples, gravity and magnetic measurements and high-pressure experiments as supporting evidence.

questions.cardText:
[Political Science] Which of the following countries is NOT ruled by a communist party?
A. Vietnam B. Laos C. Cambodia
Answer: C. Cambodia is a constitutional monarchy with a parliamentary system, despite its historical association with the Khmer Rouge regime.
questions.de: Welche Staatsform hat Kambodscha – anders als seine kommunistisch regierten Nachbarn Vietnam und Laos?
questions.en: Unlike its communist-ruled neighbours Vietnam and Laos, what form of government does Cambodia have?

timeline.labelEn: Cambodia’s current constitution is promulgated, restoring the country as a constitutional monarchy
timeline.labelDe: Kambodschas heutige Verfassung wird verkündet und macht das Land wieder zur konstitutionellen Monarchie

questions.notes: Reworked from a 'which is NOT' question to the positive fact. Card is right on the form of government, but Wikipedia adds that in practice Cambodia is authoritarian, with power centralised in the Cambodian People’s Party (which won all 125 assembly seats in 2018).
